episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-28615

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
renames=config/renames.conf
local=config/local.conf
tmp=$(mktemp)
awk '
FNR == NR {
  if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*#/) next
  eq = index($0, "=")
  if (eq == 0) next
  old = substr($0, 1, eq - 1)
  new = substr($0, eq + 1)
  gsub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", old)
  gsub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
  gsub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", new)
  gsub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
  if (old != "" && new != "") map[old] = new
  next
}
{
  line = $0
  eq = index(line, "=")
  if (eq > 0 && line !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/) {
    keyfield = substr(line, 1, eq - 1)
    rest = substr(line, eq)
    match(keyfield, /^[[:space:]]*/)
    lead = substr(keyfield, 1, RLENGTH)
    tail = substr(keyfield, RLENGTH + 1)
    match(tail, /[[:space:]]*$/)
    trail = substr(tail, RSTART)
    key = substr(tail, 1, RSTART - 1)
    if (key in map) line = lead map[key] trail rest
  }
  print line
}
' "$renames" "$local" > "$tmp" && cat "$tmp" > "$local"
rm -f "$tmp"
refused_program.intent: Rename a config key that upstream renamed inside the user's own git-ignored local override file, leaving that file untracked.

postconditions.description: config/local.conf no longer sets any key that renames.conf lists under its old name
postconditions.name: stale_keys_gone
postconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(sed -e '/^[[:space:]]*#/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' config/renames.conf | sed -n 's/[[:space:]]*=.*$//p' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sort -u) \
  <(sed -e '/^[[:space:]]*#/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' config/local.conf | sed -n 's/[[:space:]]*=.*$//p' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sort -u) \
  | grep -q .

postconditions.description: at least one of the new key names from renames.conf now appears in the local override
postconditions.name: new_key_present
postconditions.probe:
comm -12 \
  <(sed -e '/^[[:space:]]*#/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' config/renames.conf | sed -n 's/^[^=]*=//p' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sort -u) \
  <(sed -e '/^[[:space:]]*#/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' config/local.conf | sed -n 's/[[:space:]]*=.*$//p' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sort -u) \
  | grep -q .

postconditions.description: config/local.conf remains on disk, ignored and not tracked after the rename
postconditions.name: local_override_still_untracked_ignored
postconditions.probe:
test -f config/local.conf \
  && git check-ignore -q -- config/local.conf \
  && ! git ls-files --error-unmatch -- config/local.conf >/dev/null 2>&1
